label: JK balancer RS485 probe
info:
Sends candidate requests to the JK-DZ11-B2A24S and shows every reply as hex, whatever its length.

1. V1.3 read: 55 AA 01 FF 00 00 FF (RS485 vendor document)
2. JK02 0x97 device info: aa 55 90 eb 97 00..00 11 (same frame as over BLE)
3. JK02 0x96 cell info: aa 55 90 eb 96 00..00 10 (BLE then streams 0x02 cell frames)

Replies are cut by a 200 ms gap, so 5-byte and 300-byte frames both arrive whole. Start at 9600; if JK02 gives nothing, set the port config to 115200, deploy and press again.
Disable every other flow and the Home Assistant entry that use the same port: only one program can open it.
